tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)(i)
units.summary: Complete a table of protons, neutrons and electrons for two bromine isotope ions.

units.label: 1(a)(ii)
units.summary: Explain the molecular ion peaks of Br2 from isotope combinations and predict relative abundances.

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: Predict number of peaks and CH2 splitting patterns in proton NMR of two dibromoalkanes.
units.difficulty_basis: applies n+1 rule to symmetrical molecules

units.label: 2(a)(i)
units.summary: Draw the skeletal formula of 2,3-dimethylhexan-1-ol.

units.label: 2(a)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the number of hydrogen atoms in a given mass of an alcohol in standard form.

units.label: 2(b)(i)
units.summary: Explain why paracetamol does not react with sodium carbonate.

units.label: 2(b)(ii)
units.summary: Determine the masses of ibuprofen and paracetamol in a tablet from a gas volume and tablet mass.
units.difficulty_basis: multi-step with stoichiometry and scaling per tablet

units.label: 2(c)
units.summary: Calculate the pH of diluted barium hydroxide from a concentration in g per dm3.
units.difficulty_basis: five steps including dilution and Kw

units.label: 3(a)
units.summary: Explain conditions for maximum methanol yield and calculate hydrogen concentration from Kc.

units.label: 3(b)
units.summary: Determine orders, rate equation and rate constant from three experiments and explain why mechanism has several steps.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark extended with graphs and numeric data

units.label: 4(a)(i)
units.summary: Give the systematic name of the sulfite ion.

units.label: 4(a)(ii)
units.summary: Complete a flowchart of sulfite ion reactions with silver, barium, chlorine, hydrogen sulfide and dichromate.
units.difficulty_basis: seven marks of unfamiliar inorganic reactions

units.label: 4(a)(iii)
units.summary: Construct the ionic equation for sulfite reacting with acidified dichromate.

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Give the empirical formula of a nickel complex from its structure.

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Draw the amino acid ligand and the 3D structure of hexaaquanickel(II).
units.difficulty_basis: recall of ligand and octahedral structure

units.label: 4(b)(iii)
units.summary: Complete a 3D diagram of a stereoisomer of the nickel complex.
units.difficulty_basis: requires optical isomer drawing of octahedral complex

units.label: 5(a)(i)
units.summary: Give the systematic name of C6H5CH2OH.

units.label: 5(a)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the mass of LiAlH4 and the percentage yield of the alcohol.

units.label: 5(a)(iii)
units.summary: Define the term nucleophile.

units.label: 5(a)(iv)
units.summary: Complete curly arrows for the multi-step hydride reduction mechanism of an ester.

units.label: 5(a)(v)
units.summary: Suggest why the mixture is heated with dilute acid after reduction.

units.label: 5(b)
units.summary: Draw a dot-and-cross diagram for sodium borohydride with different symbols for each element.
units.difficulty_basis: ionic and covalent bonding in one species

units.label: 5(c)(i)
units.summary: Find the standard electrode potential of the negative electrode from cell and positive potentials.

units.label: 5(c)(ii)
units.summary: Construct the negative electrode equation for a borohydride fuel cell.
Calculate an enthalpy change from calorimetry data and use Hess law to find the enthalpy of decomposition of sodium hydrogencarbonate.
